scripts.copy:fontawesome: mkdir -p static/vendor/fontawesome/css static/vendor/fontawesome/webfonts && cp node_modules/@fortawesome/fontawesome-free/css/all.min.css static/vendor/fontawesome/css/all.min.css && cp -R node_modules/@fortawesome/fontawesome-free/webfonts/* static/vendor/fontawesome/webfonts/
scripts.copy:fonts: mkdir -p static/fonts/inter && cp node_modules/@fontsource/inter/files/inter-latin-400-normal.woff2 static/fonts/inter/ && cp node_modules/@fontsource/inter/files/inter-latin-500-normal.woff2 static/fonts/inter/ && cp node_modules/@fontsource/inter/files/inter-latin-600-normal.woff2 static/fonts/inter/ && cp node_modules/@fontsource/inter/files/inter-latin-700-normal.woff2 static/fonts/inter/ && cp node_modules/@fontsource/inter/files/inter-latin-800-normal.woff2 static/fonts/inter/ && cp node_modules/@fontsource/inter/files/inter-latin-900-normal.woff2 static/fonts/inter/
scripts.build:assets: npm run copy:fontawesome && npm run copy:fonts && npm run build:css
scripts.lint:php: docker run --rm --network none -v "$PWD:/app:ro" -w /app php:8.3-cli sh -lc "find wp-plugin/delivr-cm-shipping -name '*.php' -print0 | xargs -0 -n1 php -l"
